title: Clean-environment bootstrap via documented scripts
objective: Verify ./scripts/dev-up.sh && migrate.sh && seed-dev.sh yield a working app (frontend :3000, backend :8000) from a clean checkout per the cycle DoD.
preconditions: clean workspace; Docker available; .env created from .env.example per README.
steps: Copy .env.example to .env; run scripts/dev-up.sh.
Run scripts/migrate.sh; run scripts/seed-dev.sh.
Verify backend /api/v1/health/ready 200 and frontend / 200.
Verify README instructions match actual required steps.
expected_result: All scripts exit 0 with clear env banners; app reachable and login possible with seeded users; README accurate; scripts idempotent (re-running seed does not duplicate or fail).
automation_status: automatable (allowlisted commands where available; else documented manual run)

title: Script re-runnability and teardown
objective: Verify scripts are idempotent and dev-down.sh cleanly stops the stack without orphan volumes/containers (unless documented).
steps: Re-run migrate.sh and seed-dev.sh; verify exit 0 and no duplicate seed rows (asset count stable).
Run dev-down.sh; verify containers stopped.
Run dev-up.sh again; verify data persisted (documented behavior) and app healthy.
expected_result: Idempotent re-runs; clean teardown; restart preserves data per documented volume behavior; set -euo pipefail present in scripts.

title: Backend quality gates pass
objective: Verify backend CI-mirror commands pass: ruff format --check, ruff check, mypy, makemigrations --check --dry-run, Django system checks, pytest.
steps: Run each gate command via available allowlisted commands.
Record outputs and exit codes; capture pytest summary (counts, duration).
expected_result: All gates exit 0; pytest suite green; no missing migrations; type checking clean per project config.

title: Frontend quality gates pass
objective: Verify frontend CI-mirror commands pass: pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm build.
steps: Run each gate command.
Record outputs/exit codes; capture Vitest summary; verify production build artifact generated (.output).
expected_result: All gates exit 0; strict TypeScript clean; unit tests green; production build succeeds without warnings treated as errors.

title: Repo hygiene — no secrets, lockfiles present, .env ignored
objective: Verify no real secrets committed; .env git-ignored; .env.example present without real values; pnpm-lock.yaml and uv.lock (or documented alternative) committed.
test_data: grep patterns: password, secret, api_key, BEGIN.*PRIVATE KEY; file checks
steps: Scan tracked files for secret-like strings and private keys.
Verify .gitignore includes .env; verify .env is not tracked.
Verify .env.example exists with placeholder values only.
Verify lockfiles present at frontend/ and backend/.
expected_result: No secrets in tracked files (seed dev passwords documented in README only, explicitly local); .env ignored and untracked; .env.example complete but placeholder-only; both lockfiles committed.

title: Stack versions documented and ADRs for deviations
objective: Verify actual Django/Nuxt/PostgreSQL/Node/Python versions match design A-06 (newest stable policy) or have ADRs recorded in ASSUMPTIONS.md/ADRs.
steps: Extract declared versions from manifests and compose file.
Compare against A-06 policy; check for ADRs where versions deviate.
expected_result: Versions satisfy the newest-stable policy or each deviation has a recorded ADR; Python >=3.12; Node active LTS; PostgreSQL newest stable in compose.

title: E2E Journey J-6 — sign in, search, open asset
objective: End-to-end validation of the canonical Cycle-1 journey: a user signs in, uses global search, and lands on the correct asset detail.
test_data: operator credentials; known asset tag from seed
steps: Navigate to /; redirected to /login.
Sign in as operator; land on dashboard.
Type known tag into global search; select exact-match suggestion.
Verify asset detail loads with correct tag, name, status badge (icon+text), and history tab shows the creation event.
Capture screenshots at each step.
expected_result: Journey completes without errors; detail data matches seed/API truth; screenshots retained as evidence; total journey time reasonable (<10s on local stack).

title: E2E Journey J-1 (Cycle-1 slice) — register a new asset via UI
objective: End-to-end validation of asset registration: create form, validation, duplicate warning display, success state, and appearance in register + history.
preconditions: full stack seeded; Playwright; operator signed in.
test_data: new asset: name 'QA E2E Laptop', category Laptops, serial matching an existing asset to trigger duplicate warning, then unique serial
steps: Open /assets/new; submit empty (validation errors shown).
Fill required fields with a duplicate serial; observe non-blocking duplicate warning panel.
Change to unique serial; submit.
Verify success feedback, redirect to detail, correct data shown.
Verify new asset appears in /assets list and history tab shows creation event.
expected_result: Validation, duplicate warning, and success flows all behave per design; created asset matches API truth; audit/history entries visible in UI; evidence captured.
